    Monte Carlo Estimation of Empirical and Closed-Form Power for GLM PPI / PPI++

    ppi_glm_empirical_power.Rd

    Runs a full Monte Carlo study for inference on a scalar linear contrast \(\theta = a^\top\beta^\star\) under a generalized linear model (GLM), using either PPI (\(\lambda=1\)) or PPI++ (\(\lambda\in[0,1]\)).

    This function repeatedly calls ppi_glm_rep_one() to generate replicate estimates \(\hat\theta\), \(\widehat{\mathrm{se}}\), and \(\hat\lambda\), and aggregates:

    1. Empirical rejection probability (empirical power),

    2. Monte Carlo standard error of power,

    3. Estimated quadratic forms \( A = a^\top J^{-1}\Sigma_{YY}J^{-1}a,\quad B = a^\top J^{-1}\Sigma_{ff}J^{-1}a,\quad C = a^\top J^{-1}\Sigma_{Yf}J^{-1}a, \) where \(J\) is the Fisher information matrix,

    4. Closed-form asymptotic variance and Wald power for the GLM,

    5. A tidy diagnostic summary table of all variance components.

    The GLM formulation follows the canonical-score expansions described in Section~4 of the accompanying manuscript. For logistic regression, \(J = \mathbb{E}[\,\mu(1-\mu)XX^\top\,]\).

    ppi_glm_empirical_power(
  R,
  n,
  N,
  X_sampler_L,
  f_generator,
  model_type,
  a,
  delta,
  theta0,
  ppi_type = c("PPI", "PPI++"),
  lambda_mode = c("plugin", "oracle"),
  lambda_external = FALSE,
  n_external = ceiling(n/2),
  PPIpp_crossfit = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 1,
  keep_reps = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    R

    Number of Monte Carlo repetitions.

    n

    Number of labeled observations.

    N

    Number of unlabeled observations.

    X_sampler_L

    Function that generates labeled covariates \(X_L\).

    f_generator

    Function generating the true linear predictor \(\eta(X)\), before applying the logistic (or general GLM) link.

    model_type

    Predictive model class for the nuisance predictor \(\mu_f\), e.g.\ "glm_correct", "glm_wrong", "rf".

    a

    Contrast vector \(a\in\mathbb{R}^p\).

    delta

    Effect size injected via \(\eta_\delta(x) = \eta(x) + \delta\,x^\top a\).

    theta0

    Null value of the contrast \(\theta\).

    ppi_type

    "PPI" or "PPI++".

    lambda_mode

    "plugin" or "oracle". Only "plugin" is implemented internally.

    lambda_external

    Logical; whether to estimate \(\lambda\) from an external labeled sample.

    n_external

    Size of the external labeled sample (if used).

    PPIpp_crossfit

    Logical; whether to use 2-fold cross-fitting for PPI++.

    alpha

    Wald test significance level.

    seed

    Optional random seed.

    keep_reps

    Logical; if TRUE, return the full list of replicate outputs from ppi_glm_rep_one().

    Value

    A list with:

    empirical_power

    Empirical rejection probability over \(R\) reps.

    theoretical_power

    Closed-form Wald power (GLM).

    mc_se

    Monte Carlo standard error of empirical power.

    avg_theta_hat

    Mean of \(\hat\theta\).

    avg_se_hat

    Mean estimated standard error.

    avg_lambda_hat

    Mean of the fitted \(\hat\lambda\).

    lambda_star_hat

    Closed-form minimizer \(\lambda^\star(a)\) of the GLM variance (oracle value).

    se_theory

    Closed-form asymptotic standard error for the GLM contrast.

    cov_var_table

    A tidy tibble summarizing \(A\), \(B\), \(C\), \(\lambda\), condition number diagnostics, and theoretical variance/power.

    reps

    (Optional) Raw replicate-level results, if keep_reps = TRUE.

    Details

    The GLM variance decomposition uses: $$ \mathrm{Var}\big(a^\top\hat\beta_\lambda\big) \approx a^\top J^{-1}\!\left( \frac{\Sigma_{YY}}{n} + \lambda^2\Big(\frac{\Sigma_{ff}}{N}+\frac{\Sigma_{ff}}{n}\Big) - \frac{2\lambda}{n}\Sigma_{Yf} \right)J^{-1}a, $$ where \(J\) is the Fisher information matrix.

    The effect size shift used for power calculations is \(\theta_\delta - \theta_0 = \delta\,\|a\|_2^2\).
